name: @kitty-crow/neru
description: Boot a kernel-only Linux-WASM runtime over the live mikuOS userspace.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --check bin/neru-linux-runtime.mjs && node --check runtime/node-worker-bootstrap.mjs && node --check runtime/node-mikuosfs.mjs && python3 -m py_compile scripts/prepare-kernel.py scripts/prepare-userland.py scripts/make-rv64-smoke.py
scripts.test: npm run build && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && node --test tests/*.test.mjs dist/tests/*.test.js
